clips.noHook.en: No ad text yet: this clip was picked from footage, not a script. You write the TikTok ad text when you choose the ad in a campaign.
clips.noHook.zh: 还没有广告文案：这条切片按画面选出，没有台词。在广告活动中选中广告时，由你来写 TikTok 广告文案。

clips.none.hint.en: Clips are cut automatically a few minutes after an episode video is uploaded: 20–30 second vertical cuts, ready for TikTok or Meta.
clips.none.hint.zh: 分集视频上传后几分钟内会自动切出 20–30 秒的竖版片段，可直接用于 TikTok 或 Meta 广告。

clips.cutting.hint.en: Cutting runs in the background; this list refreshes on its own.
clips.cutting.hint.zh: 正在后台切片，列表会自动刷新。

angles.direct_clip.hint.en: 20–30 second cuts of the drama itself; the hook is the ad's text, nothing is burned into the picture. Each reserves {min} of the planned budget.
angles.direct_clip.hint.zh: 剧集本身的 20–30 秒直剪；开场文字作为广告文案，不会烧录进画面。每条占用 {min} 计划预算。

angles.narration.hint.en: A voice tells the story over the footage. Coming soon.
angles.narration.hint.zh: 配音解说剧情。即将推出。

angles.slots.full.en: Slots full. Unselect an ad, or raise the budget in the brief to open more.
angles.slots.full.zh: 名额已满。取消一条广告，或在方案中提高预算以增加名额。

angles.slots.none.en: Set a budget in the brief to open ad slots.
angles.slots.none.zh: 先在方案中设置预算，才有广告名额。

angles.budgetCovers.en: Budget {budget} covers {covers} ads at {min} each · {chosen} chosen
angles.budgetCovers.zh: 预算 {budget} 可投 {covers} 条广告（每条 {min}）· 已选 {chosen} 条

angles.overBudget.en: {chosen} ads chosen but the budget covers {covers}. Unselect {over} or raise the budget in the brief.
angles.overBudget.zh: 已选 {chosen} 条，但预算只够 {covers} 条。请取消 {over} 条，或在方案中提高预算。

angles.slots.sharedNote.en: Slots are planning capacity: the budget runs as one shared TikTok ad group, and each ad needs about {min} to learn anything. Delivery is not split per ad.
angles.slots.sharedNote.zh: 名额是计划容量：预算作为一个共享的 TikTok 广告组投放，每条广告大约需要 {min} 才能看出结果。投放不会按条平均分配。

angles.slots.belowOne.en: The budget is below one ad slot ({min}). Raise it in the brief before choosing ads.
angles.slots.belowOne.zh: 预算不足一个广告名额（{min}）。请先在方案中提高预算，再选择广告。

promote.workspace.clipsReadyHint.en: Every finished clip becomes a candidate ad with its file already cut. Choose the ones to test, then approve.
promote.workspace.clipsReadyHint.zh: 每条已完成的切片都会成为候选广告，文件已切好。选出要测试的广告后批准即可。

promote.workspace.generateFrom.zh: 从 {n} 条切片生成广告

promote.workspace.noClipsHint.en: Ads are cut from the episodes' clips; none is finished for this title. Cut them now and come back when they are ready.
promote.workspace.noClipsHint.zh: 广告来自分集切片，这部剧集还没有完成的切片。现在开始切片，完成后再回来。

promote.workspace.cuttingHint.en: {n} episodes are being cut in the background. This page refreshes on its own; generate the ads once clips are ready.
promote.workspace.cuttingHint.zh: 正在后台切 {n} 集的片段。页面会自动刷新，切片完成后即可生成广告。

promote.workspace.addClips.zh: 把 {n} 条新切片加为广告

fc.adText.en: TikTok ad text · sent exactly like this
fc.adText.zh: TikTok 广告文案 · 原样提交

fc.adTextCut.en: TikTok shows the first {n} characters; the rest is not sent.
fc.adTextCut.zh: TikTok 只显示前 {n} 个字符，其余不会提交。

fc.launchSummary.en: Launch summary: {n} ads · viewers go to {destination} · United States · TikTok website traffic, optimized for clicks.
fc.launchSummary.zh: 投放摘要：{n} 条广告 · 观众跳转到 {destination} · 美国 · TikTok 网站流量，按点击优化。

promote.new.deliveryFact.en: United States · website traffic to your destination link, optimized for clicks. These are the only settings the launch sends; nothing else on this form changes delivery.
promote.new.deliveryFact.zh: 美国 · 网站流量，跳转到你的落地页链接，按点击优化。投放只会发送这些设置，本表单的其他内容不影响投放。

promote.new.goalNote.en: For your records. TikTok is always set to website traffic; this does not change delivery.
promote.new.goalNote.zh: 仅作记录。TikTok 始终按网站流量投放，此项不影响投放。

promote.new.spoilerHint2.en: A note that rides with the brief for Pulsar's review. Clips are chosen per episode from the script; this does not filter them automatically.
promote.new.spoilerHint2.zh: 随方案一起给 Pulsar 审核的备注。切片按每集台词选出，此项不会自动过滤。

promote.new.notesHint.en: Direction and content to avoid are review notes, not automatic filters.
promote.new.notesHint.zh: 创意方向和避免内容是审核备注，不是自动过滤。

clips.previewHint.en: Shown at phone proportions: this is what an ad viewer sees.
clips.previewHint.zh: 按手机比例显示：这就是广告观众看到的画面。

admin.episodeNext.videoOnly.en: Video only: ad clips are cut automatically; subtitles are optional for ads
admin.episodeNext.videoOnly.zh: 仅有视频：广告切片会自动生成；做广告不需要字幕

admin.episodeNext.clipsReady.en: {n} ad clips ready — the producer chooses ads in a campaign
admin.episodeNext.clipsReady.zh: {n} 条广告切片可用，制片方在广告活动中选择

fc.adTextMissing.en: Not written yet. Until you write it, TikTok would show: “{fallback}”
fc.adTextMissing.zh: 还没有写。写好之前，TikTok 会显示：“{fallback}”

fc.adTextHint.en: Shown above the video on TikTok, next to your account name. {left} characters left.
fc.adTextHint.zh: 显示在 TikTok 视频上方、账号名旁边。还可输入 {left} 个字符。
